traitScope: Pinned source metadata; not versioned Gen V rules or simulated outcomes

1.name: pound
1.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

2.name: karate-chop
2.description: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

3.name: double-slap
3.description: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

4.name: comet-punch
4.description: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

5.name: mega-punch
5.description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

6.name: pay-day
6.description: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.

7.name: fire-punch
7.description: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may also leave the target with a burn.

8.name: ice-punch
8.description: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.

9.name: thunder-punch
9.description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

10.name: scratch
10.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

11.name: vice-grip
11.description: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

12.name: guillotine
12.description: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

13.name: razor-wind
13.description: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

14.name: swords-dance
14.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

15.name: cut
15.description: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

16.name: gust
16.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

17.name: wing-attack
17.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

18.name: whirlwind
18.description: The target is blown away and switched. In the wild, a battle against a single Pokémon ends.

19.name: fly
19.description: The user soars, then strikes its target on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

20.name: bind
20.description: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

21.name: slam
21.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

22.name: vine-whip
22.description: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

23.name: stomp
23.description: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

24.name: double-kick
24.description: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

25.name: mega-kick
25.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

26.name: jump-kick
26.description: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

27.name: rolling-kick
27.description: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. It may also make the target flinch.

28.name: sand-attack
28.description: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing its accuracy.

29.name: headbutt
29.description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. It may also make the target flinch.

30.name: horn-attack
30.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

31.name: fury-attack
31.description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

32.name: horn-drill
32.description: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

33.name: tackle
33.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

34.name: body-slam
34.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

35.name: wrap
35.description: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

36.name: take-down
36.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. It also damages the user a little.

37.name: thrash
37.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

38.name: double-edge
38.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

39.name: tail-whip
39.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

40.name: poison-sting
40.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

41.name: twineedle
41.description: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. It may also poison the target.

42.name: pin-missile
42.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

43.name: leer
43.description: The user gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The opposing team’s Defense stats are reduced.

44.name: bite
44.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

45.name: growl
45.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the opposing team less wary. The foes’ Attack stats are lowered.

46.name: roar
46.description: The target is scared off and switched. In the wild, a battle against a single Pokémon ends.

47.name: sing
47.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

48.name: supersonic
48.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

49.name: sonic-boom
49.description: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

50.name: disable
50.description: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

51.name: acid
51.description: The opposing team is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. The acid may also lower the targets’ Sp. Def stats.

52.name: ember
52.description: The target is attacked with small flames. It may also leave the target with a burn.

53.name: flamethrower
53.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

54.name: mist
54.description: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

55.name: water-gun
55.description: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

56.name: hydro-pump
56.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

57.name: surf
57.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

58.name: ice-beam
58.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

59.name: blizzard
59.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

60.name: psybeam
60.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

61.name: bubble-beam
61.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the opposing team. It may also lower their Speed stats.

62.name: aurora-beam
62.description: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

63.name: hyper-beam
63.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

64.name: peck
64.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

65.name: drill-peck
65.description: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

66.name: submission
66.description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

67.name: low-kick
67.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier targets.

68.name: counter
68.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

69.name: seismic-toss
69.description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

70.name: strength
70.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

71.name: absorb
71.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

72.name: mega-drain
72.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

73.name: leech-seed
73.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

74.name: growth
74.description: The user’s body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

75.name: razor-leaf
75.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

76.name: solar-beam
76.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

77.name: poison-powder
77.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

78.name: stun-spore
78.description: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may leave the target with paralysis.

79.name: sleep-powder
79.description: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

80.name: petal-dance
80.description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

81.name: string-shot
81.description: The targets are bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. This silk reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

82.name: dragon-rage
82.description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

83.name: fire-spin
83.description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

84.name: thunder-shock
84.description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

85.name: thunderbolt
85.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

86.name: thunder-wave
86.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

87.name: thunder
87.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

88.name: rock-throw
88.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

89.name: earthquake
89.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes those around it.

90.name: fissure
90.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

91.name: dig
91.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

92.name: toxic
92.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

93.name: confusion
93.description: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

94.name: psychic
94.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.

95.name: hypnosis
95.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

96.name: meditate
96.description: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

97.name: agility
97.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

98.name: quick-attack
98.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

99.name: rage
99.description: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

100.name: teleport
100.description: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.

101.name: night-shade
101.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.

102.name: mimic
102.description: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

103.name: screech
103.description: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target’s Defense stat.

104.name: double-team
104.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

105.name: recover
105.description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

106.name: harden
106.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

107.name: minimize
107.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

108.name: smokescreen
108.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target’s accuracy.

109.name: confuse-ray
109.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

110.name: withdraw
110.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

111.name: defense-curl
111.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

112.name: barrier
112.description: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

113.name: light-screen
113.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

114.name: haze
114.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

115.name: reflect
115.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

116.name: focus-energy
116.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

117.name: bide
117.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

118.name: metronome
118.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

119.name: mirror-move
119.description: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.

120.name: self-destruct
120.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

121.name: egg-bomb
121.description: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

122.name: lick
122.description: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

123.name: smog
123.description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

124.name: sludge
124.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

125.name: bone-club
125.description: The user clubs the target with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.

126.name: fire-blast
126.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

127.name: waterfall
127.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

128.name: clamp
128.description: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

129.name: swift
129.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

130.name: skull-bash
130.description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

131.name: spike-cannon
131.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

132.name: constrict
132.description: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

133.name: amnesia
133.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

134.name: kinesis
134.description: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target’s accuracy.

135.name: soft-boiled
135.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

136.name: high-jump-kick
136.description: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

137.name: glare
137.description: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

138.name: dream-eater
138.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

139.name: poison-gas
139.description: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

140.name: barrage
140.description: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

141.name: leech-life
141.description: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

142.name: lovely-kiss
142.description: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

143.name: sky-attack
143.description: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.

144.name: transform
144.description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

145.name: bubble
145.description: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ Speed stats.

146.name: dizzy-punch
146.description: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.

147.name: spore
147.description: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

148.name: flash
148.description: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

149.name: psywave
149.description: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

150.name: splash
150.description: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

151.name: acid-armor
151.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

152.name: crabhammer
152.description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

153.name: explosion
153.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

154.name: fury-swipes
154.description: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

155.name: bonemerang
155.description: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the target twice, coming and going.

156.name: rest
156.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

157.name: rock-slide
157.description: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing team to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

158.name: hyper-fang
158.description: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.

159.name: sharpen
159.description: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

160.name: conversion
160.description: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

161.name: tri-attack
161.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or leave the target with paralysis.

162.name: super-fang
162.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.

163.name: slash
163.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

164.name: substitute
164.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

165.name: struggle
165.description: An attack that is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also hurts the user slightly.

166.name: sketch
166.description: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

167.name: triple-kick
167.description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

168.name: thief
168.description: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

169.name: spider-web
169.description: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.

170.name: mind-reader
170.description: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

171.name: nightmare
171.description: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

172.name: flame-wheel
172.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

173.name: snore
173.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

174.name: curse
174.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

175.name: flail
175.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

176.name: conversion-2
176.description: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

177.name: aeroblast
177.description: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.

178.name: cotton-spore
178.description: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the target, harshly reducing its Speed stat.

179.name: reversal
179.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

180.name: spite
180.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

181.name: powder-snow
181.description: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the targets.

182.name: protect
182.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

183.name: mach-punch
183.description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

184.name: scary-face
184.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

185.name: feint-attack
185.description: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

186.name: sweet-kiss
186.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

187.name: belly-drum
187.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

188.name: sludge-bomb
188.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

189.name: mud-slap
189.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

190.name: octazooka
190.description: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

191.name: spikes
191.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

192.name: zap-cannon
192.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

193.name: foresight
193.description: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

194.name: destiny-bond
194.description: When this move is used, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints.

195.name: perish-song
195.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

196.name: icy-wind
196.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

197.name: detect
197.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

198.name: bone-rush
198.description: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

199.name: lock-on
199.description: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

200.name: outrage
200.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

201.name: sandstorm
201.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

202.name: giga-drain
202.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

203.name: endure
203.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

204.name: charm
204.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is harshly lowered.

205.name: rollout
205.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

206.name: false-swipe
206.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

207.name: swagger
207.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

208.name: milk-drink
208.description: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

209.name: spark
209.description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

210.name: fury-cutter
210.description: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

211.name: steel-wing
211.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

212.name: mean-look
212.description: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

213.name: attract
213.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

214.name: sleep-talk
214.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

215.name: heal-bell
215.description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

216.name: return
216.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

217.name: present
217.description: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

218.name: frustration
218.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

219.name: safeguard
219.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

220.name: pain-split
220.description: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

221.name: sacred-fire
221.description: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.

222.name: magnitude
222.description: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.

223.name: dynamic-punch
223.description: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

224.name: megahorn
224.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

225.name: dragon-breath
225.description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

226.name: baton-pass
226.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

227.name: encore
227.description: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

228.name: pursuit
228.description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

229.name: rapid-spin
229.description: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.

230.name: sweet-scent
230.description: A sweet scent that lowers the opposing team’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

231.name: iron-tail
231.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

232.name: metal-claw
232.description: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

233.name: vital-throw
233.description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

234.name: morning-sun
234.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

235.name: synthesis
235.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

236.name: moonlight
236.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

237.name: hidden-power
237.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

238.name: cross-chop
238.description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

239.name: twister
239.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

240.name: rain-dance
240.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

241.name: sunny-day
241.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

242.name: crunch
242.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

243.name: mirror-coat
243.description: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

244.name: psych-up
244.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

245.name: extreme-speed
245.description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

246.name: ancient-power
246.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

247.name: shadow-ball
247.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

248.name: future-sight
248.description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

249.name: rock-smash
249.description: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

250.name: whirlpool
250.description: Traps foes in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

251.name: beat-up
251.description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

252.name: fake-out
252.description: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

253.name: uproar
253.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

254.name: stockpile
254.description: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

255.name: spit-up
255.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the damage.

256.name: swallow
256.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP. Storing more power heals more HP.

257.name: heat-wave
257.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.

258.name: hail
258.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

259.name: torment
259.description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

260.name: flatter
260.description: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

261.name: will-o-wisp
261.description: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

262.name: memento
262.description: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk.

263.name: facade
263.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.

264.name: focus-punch
264.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

265.name: smelling-salts
265.description: This attack inflicts double damage on a target with paralysis. It also cures the target’s paralysis, however.

266.name: follow-me
266.description: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

267.name: nature-power
267.description: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

268.name: charge
268.description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. It also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

269.name: taunt
269.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

270.name: helping-hand
270.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

271.name: trick
271.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

272.name: role-play
272.description: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s natural Ability.

273.name: wish
273.description: One turn after this move is used, the target’s HP is restored by half the user’s maximum HP.

274.name: assist
274.description: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

275.name: ingrain
275.description: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

276.name: superpower
276.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

277.name: magic-coat
277.description: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

278.name: recycle
278.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

279.name: revenge
279.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

280.name: brick-break
280.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

281.name: yawn
281.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

282.name: knock-off
282.description: The user slaps down the target’s held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

283.name: endeavor
283.description: An attack move that cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

284.name: eruption
284.description: The user attacks the opposing team with explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

285.name: skill-swap
285.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

286.name: imprison
286.description: If the opponents know any move also known by the user, the opponents are prevented from using it.

287.name: refresh
287.description: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

288.name: grudge
288.description: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.

289.name: snatch
289.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the opponent attempts to use.

290.name: secret-power
290.description: The user attacks the target with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

291.name: dive
291.description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the second turn. It can be used to dive deep in the ocean.

292.name: arm-thrust
292.description: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

293.name: camouflage
293.description: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.

294.name: tail-glow
294.description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

295.name: luster-purge
295.description: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.

296.name: mist-ball
296.description: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk.

297.name: feather-dance
297.description: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

298.name: teeter-dance
298.description: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

299.name: blaze-kick
299.description: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. It may also leave the target with a burn.

300.name: mud-sport
300.description: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric-type moves while the user is in the battle.

301.name: ice-ball
301.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

302.name: needle-arm
302.description: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.

303.name: slack-off
303.description: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

304.name: hyper-voice
304.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

305.name: poison-fang
305.description: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. It may also leave the target badly poisoned.

306.name: crush-claw
306.description: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target’s Defense.

307.name: blast-burn
307.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

308.name: hydro-cannon
308.description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

309.name: meteor-mash
309.description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user’s Attack.

310.name: astonish
310.description: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

311.name: weather-ball
311.description: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.

312.name: aromatherapy
312.description: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user’s party.

313.name: fake-tears
313.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

314.name: air-cutter
314.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

315.name: overheat
315.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

316.name: odor-sleuth
316.description: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit with Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

317.name: rock-tomb
317.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target’s Speed by preventing its movement.

318.name: silver-wind
318.description: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

319.name: metal-sound
319.description: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.

320.name: grass-whistle
320.description: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.

321.name: tickle
321.description: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

322.name: cosmic-power
322.description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

323.name: water-spout
323.description: The user spouts water to damage the opposing team. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful it becomes.

324.name: signal-beam
324.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

325.name: shadow-punch
325.description: The user throws a punch from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.

326.name: extrasensory
326.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

327.name: sky-uppercut
327.description: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

328.name: sand-tomb
328.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

329.name: sheer-cold
329.description: The target is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The target instantly faints if it hits.

330.name: muddy-water
330.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets’ accuracy.

331.name: bullet-seed
331.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

332.name: aerial-ace
332.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

333.name: icicle-spear
333.description: The user launches sharp icicles at the target. It strikes two to five times in a row.

334.name: iron-defense
334.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

335.name: block
335.description: The user blocks the target’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

336.name: howl
336.description: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

337.name: dragon-claw
337.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

338.name: frenzy-plant
338.description: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

339.name: bulk-up
339.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

340.name: bounce
340.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

341.name: mud-shot
341.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. It also reduces the target’s Speed.

342.name: poison-tail
342.description: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

343.name: covet
343.description: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target’s held item.

344.name: volt-tackle
344.description: The user electrifies itself, then charges. It causes considerable damage to the user and may leave the target with paralysis.

345.name: magical-leaf
345.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack will not miss.

346.name: water-sport
346.description: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

347.name: calm-mind
347.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

348.name: leaf-blade
348.description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

349.name: dragon-dance
349.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

350.name: rock-blast
350.description: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

351.name: shock-wave
351.description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

352.name: water-pulse
352.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

353.name: doom-desire
353.description: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

354.name: psycho-boost
354.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

355.name: roost
355.description: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

356.name: gravity
356.description: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitate.

357.name: miracle-eye
357.description: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

358.name: wake-up-slap
358.description: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up, however.

359.name: hammer-arm
359.description: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

360.name: gyro-ball
360.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

361.name: healing-wish
361.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

362.name: brine
362.description: If the target’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

363.name: natural-gift
363.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

364.name: feint
364.description: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

365.name: pluck
365.description: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

366.name: tailwind
366.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.

367.name: acupressure
367.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

368.name: metal-burst
368.description: The user retaliates with much greater power against the target that last inflicted damage on it.

369.name: u-turn
369.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

370.name: close-combat
370.description: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

371.name: payback
371.description: If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

372.name: assurance
372.description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

373.name: embargo
373.description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

374.name: fling
374.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

375.name: psycho-shift
375.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

376.name: trump-card
376.description: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.

377.name: heal-block
377.description: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

378.name: wring-out
378.description: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack’s power.

379.name: power-trick
379.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

380.name: gastro-acid
380.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.

381.name: lucky-chant
381.description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits.

382.name: me-first
382.description: The user tries to cut ahead of the target to steal and use the target’s intended move with greater power.

383.name: copycat
383.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

384.name: power-swap
384.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target.

385.name: guard-swap
385.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

386.name: punishment
386.description: This attack’s power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

387.name: last-resort
387.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

388.name: worry-seed
388.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.

389.name: sucker-punch
389.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

390.name: toxic-spikes
390.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the opponent’s feet. They poison opponents that switch into battle.

391.name: heart-swap
391.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

392.name: aqua-ring
392.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

393.name: magnet-rise
393.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

394.name: flare-blitz
394.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. The user sustains serious damage and may leave the target burned.

395.name: force-palm
395.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

396.name: aura-sphere
396.description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This move is certain to hit.

397.name: rock-polish
397.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

398.name: poison-jab
398.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the target.

399.name: dark-pulse
399.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

400.name: night-slash
400.description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

401.name: aqua-tail
401.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

402.name: seed-bomb
402.description: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

403.name: air-slash
403.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

404.name: x-scissor
404.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

405.name: bug-buzz
405.description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

406.name: dragon-pulse
406.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

407.name: dragon-rush
407.description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

408.name: power-gem
408.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

409.name: drain-punch
409.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

410.name: vacuum-wave
410.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

411.name: focus-blast
411.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

412.name: energy-ball
412.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

413.name: brave-bird
413.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

414.name: earth-power
414.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

415.name: switcheroo
415.description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

416.name: giga-impact
416.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

417.name: nasty-plot
417.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

418.name: bullet-punch
418.description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

419.name: avalanche
419.description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

420.name: ice-shard
420.description: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

421.name: shadow-claw
421.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

422.name: thunder-fang
422.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

423.name: ice-fang
423.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

424.name: fire-fang
424.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it burned.

425.name: shadow-sneak
425.description: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

426.name: mud-bomb
426.description: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

427.name: psycho-cut
427.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

428.name: zen-headbutt
428.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. It may also make the target flinch.

429.name: mirror-shot
429.description: The user looses a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

430.name: flash-cannon
430.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

431.name: rock-climb
431.description: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.

432.name: defog
432.description: A strong wind blows away the target’s obstacles such as Reflect or Light Screen. It also lowers the target’s evasiveness.

433.name: trick-room
433.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

434.name: draco-meteor
434.description: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

435.name: discharge
435.description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

436.name: lava-plume
436.description: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.

437.name: leaf-storm
437.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

438.name: power-whip
438.description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.

439.name: rock-wrecker
439.description: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

440.name: cross-poison
440.description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also leave the target poisoned. Critical hits land more easily.

441.name: gunk-shot
441.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

442.name: iron-head
442.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

443.name: magnet-bomb
443.description: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

444.name: stone-edge
444.description: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

445.name: captivate
445.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

446.name: stealth-rock
446.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opponent’s team. The trap hurts opponents that switch into battle.

447.name: grass-knot
447.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

448.name: chatter
448.description: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the target.

449.name: judgment
449.description: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

450.name: bug-bite
450.description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

451.name: charge-beam
451.description: The user attacks with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

452.name: wood-hammer
452.description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

453.name: aqua-jet
453.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

454.name: attack-order
454.description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

455.name: defend-order
455.description: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

456.name: heal-order
456.description: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

457.name: head-smash
457.description: The user attacks the target with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.

458.name: double-hit
458.description: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

459.name: roar-of-time
459.description: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

460.name: spacial-rend
460.description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

461.name: lunar-dance
461.description: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

462.name: crush-grip
462.description: The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.

463.name: magma-storm
463.description: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.

464.name: dark-void
464.description: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

465.name: seed-flare
465.description: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. It may harshly lower the target’s Sp. Def.

466.name: ominous-wind
466.description: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

467.name: shadow-force
467.description: The user disappears, then strikes the target on the second turn. It hits even if the target protects itself.

468.name: hone-claws
468.description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

469.name: wide-guard
469.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

470.name: guard-split
470.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of its target’s.

471.name: power-split
471.description: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target’s.

472.name: wonder-room
472.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

473.name: psyshock
473.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

474.name: venoshock
474.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. Its power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

475.name: autotomize
475.description: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

476.name: rage-powder
476.description: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

477.name: telekinesis
477.description: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

478.name: magic-room
478.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.

479.name: smack-down
479.description: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack an opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

480.name: storm-throw
480.description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

481.name: flame-burst
481.description: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.

482.name: sludge-wave
482.description: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

483.name: quiver-dance
483.description: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

484.name: heavy-slam
484.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater its damage.

485.name: synchronoise
485.description: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.

486.name: electro-ball
486.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the damage.

487.name: soak
487.description: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.

488.name: flame-charge
488.description: The user cloaks itself with flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user’s Speed stat.

489.name: coil
489.description: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

490.name: low-sweep
490.description: The user attacks the target’s legs swiftly, reducing the target’s Speed stat.

491.name: acid-spray
491.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target’s Sp. Def stat.

492.name: foul-play
492.description: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage.

493.name: simple-beam
493.description: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.

494.name: entrainment
494.description: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s.

495.name: after-you
495.description: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

496.name: round
496.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

497.name: echoed-voice
497.description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

498.name: chip-away
498.description: Looking for an opening, the user strikes continually. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

499.name: clear-smog
499.description: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

500.name: stored-power
500.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the damage.

501.name: quick-guard
501.description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If used in succession, its chance of failing rises.

502.name: ally-switch
502.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

503.name: scald
503.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

504.name: shell-smash
504.description: The user breaks its shell, lowering its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raising Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

505.name: heal-pulse
505.description: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

506.name: hex
506.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

507.name: sky-drop
507.description: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

508.name: shift-gear
508.description: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

509.name: circle-throw
509.description: The target is thrown and switched. In the wild, a battle against a single Pokémon ends.

510.name: incinerate
510.description: The user attacks the target with fire. If the target is holding a Berry, the Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

511.name: quash
511.description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

512.name: acrobatics
512.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

513.name: reflect-type
513.description: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.

514.name: retaliate
514.description: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this attack’s damage increases.

515.name: final-gambit
515.description: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to the user’s HP.

516.name: bestow
516.description: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.

517.name: inferno
517.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.

518.name: water-pledge
518.description: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, the damage increases and a rainbow appears.

519.name: fire-pledge
519.description: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, its damage increases into a vast sea of fire.

520.name: grass-pledge
520.description: A column of grass hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its water equivalent, its damage increases into a vast swamp.

521.name: volt-switch
521.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

522.name: struggle-bug
522.description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets’ Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

523.name: bulldoze
523.description: The user stomps down on the ground and attacks everything in the area. Hit Pokémon’s Speed stat is reduced.

524.name: frost-breath
524.description: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

525.name: dragon-tail
525.description: The target is knocked away and switched. In the wild, a battle against a single Pokémon ends.

526.name: work-up
526.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

527.name: electroweb
527.description: The user captures and attacks opposing Pokémon by using an electric net. It reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

528.name: wild-charge
528.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. It also damages the user a little.

529.name: drill-run
529.description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

530.name: dual-chop
530.description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

531.name: heart-stamp
531.description: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. It may also make the target flinch.

532.name: horn-leech
532.description: The user drains the target’s energy with its horns. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

533.name: sacred-sword
533.description: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

534.name: razor-shell
534.description: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This attack may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

535.name: heat-crash
535.description: The user slams its target with its flame- covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the damage.

536.name: leaf-tornado
536.description: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.

537.name: steamroller
537.description: The user crushes its targets by rolling over them with its rolled-up body. This attack may make the target flinch.

538.name: cotton-guard
538.description: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically raising the user’s Defense stat.

539.name: night-daze
539.description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

540.name: psystrike
540.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

541.name: tail-slap
541.description: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

542.name: hurricane
542.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the target.

543.name: head-charge
543.description: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. It also damages the user a little.

544.name: gear-grind
544.description: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at its target.

545.name: searing-shot
545.description: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.

546.name: techno-blast
546.description: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

547.name: relic-song
547.description: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of those listening. It may also induce sleep.

548.name: secret-sword
548.description: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn does physical damage to the target.

549.name: glaciate
549.description: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This attack reduces the targets’ Speed stat.

550.name: bolt-strike
550.description: The user charges its target, surrounding itself with a great amount of electricity. It may leave the target with paralysis.

551.name: blue-flare
551.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

552.name: fiery-dance
552.description: Cloaked in flames, the user dances and flaps its wings. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

553.name: freeze-shock
553.description: On the second turn, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice. It may leave the target with paralysis.

554.name: ice-burn
554.description: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the target. This may leave the target with a burn.

555.name: snarl
555.description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the targets’ Sp. Atk stat decrease.

556.name: icicle-crash
556.description: The user attacks by harshly dropping an icicle onto the target. It may also make the target flinch.

557.name: v-create
557.description: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. It lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

558.name: fusion-flare
558.description: The user brings down a giant flame. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.

559.name: fusion-bolt
559.description: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. This attack does greater damage when influenced by an enormous flame.
